notes: Paper (An, Pospelov, Pradler, Ritz 2020) constrains DARK PHOTONS (kinetic mixing epsilon), NOT axion-electron; the pre-analysis hint is incorrect. The genuinely new limit is the XENON1T S2-only constraint on SOLAR dark photon emission (red line, Fig.1 left panel), a Stueckelberg 'hard mass' vector coupled to the electron vector current. This is a solar-emission bound, so no local DM density applies (density set null). Data points are approximate read-offs from the log-log Fig.1 left panel (mV 1e-3 to ~1e3 eV) and are uncertain. The paper also fits keV dark photon DARK MATTER absorption to the XENON1T excess (right panel, rho_dm=0.3 GeV/cm^3, best fit mA'=2.8 keV, eps=8.4e-16), but those favored regions/official XENON1T limits are not the authors' primary new exclusion. Limits are 90% C.L.
